title: Western, Religious or Spiritual: An Evaluation of Moral Justification in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Presenting LLMs with everyday moral dilemmas and asking them to justify their recommendations by selecting from a provided list of Western, Abrahamic, and Spiritualist moral principles to measure preference for Western traditions.

Prompting models to evaluate the moral permissibility of universally immoral or morally ambiguous actions when they are justified using Abrahamic or Spiritualist principles, measuring whether the models incorrectly classify them as moral due to religious over-alignment.
